title: Grade 6 field trip: City Zoo & Science Park
description: A full-day educational visit with teachers and attendants. Bus leaves at 8:00 am and returns by 4:30 pm. Packed lunch required.
consentText: I give permission for my child to take part in the school trip to City Zoo & Science Park, and I accept the school’s safety guidelines. I understand my child will travel by the school bus.
